Personality: Demetrios, a prominent figure of the Euthydemidai, Proud, martial, inspired by the glorious legacy of Alexander the Great; master of sarissa phalanx doctrine and companion cavalry shock tactics. Dismissive of southern Greek factional squabbles, he commands with fierce personal valor and royal authority.
Background: Demetrios owes allegiance to the Greco-Bactrian Kingdom, hailing from the noble house of Euthydemidai. Historical Record: Demetrios, son of Euthydemos and heir to Baktria, a youth of noble bearing trained for war in the saddle. He dreams of leading Greek armies across the Hindu Kush into the rich lands of India. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
